merged_pull_requests.title: Add complex and Kähler geometry roadmap
observations: The review at 8b03be5 requested five substantive repairs: an accessible supplier contract, a missing existence construction, rank-generalizing assembly, a metric-convention adapter, and a corrected surface-theory supplier.
The follow-up at 13b2335e closed those five findings but kept a later ownership correction open. The author named the exact corrective commit; a subsequent APPROVED event preceded merge.

The description distinguishes written dependency contracts from implementation, and confines the suggested signatures to non-exhaustive targets with admissions. Historical proposed suppliers in this discussion are not treated as current-main dependencies.
relevance_to_draft: Keep exact supplier sections and owned bridges, fixed-model/rank hypotheses and explicit comparison constructions.
Record closure against the actual corrected snapshot; a prior review pass does not close a later ownership defect.
Preserve the separation of roadmap specification, prototype compilation, mathematical proof and repository approval.

merged_pull_requests.title: Roadmap: formal Laurent fields, Puiseux expansions and differential calculus
observations: The new roadmap changes precisely its README, Suggested.lean and metadata.toml under one directory and targets main.
The PR description names native carriers, the separate geometric owner, targeted build validation, and the authoring/review models.
Its only returned discussion entry is a bodyless APPROVED review. It gives no detailed reviewer reasoning to borrow.
relevance_to_draft: Use a focused own-directory submission with explicit ownership boundaries and model attribution.
Describe the prototype as signature/API evidence; the future mathematical results remain requested work.

merged_pull_requests.title: SchemeAndStackFoundations: depth of Hom, isomorphisms across depth two, reflexive extension without integrality (§§0.6, 0.17)
observations: This is a merged README-only extension to an existing neighboring roadmap, not a third new-area proposal.
The mathematical review checks the extra proof route supporting a genuinely wider non-integral theorem; it does not accept removing a source hypothesis without an argument.
The textual APPROVE verdict was submitted as COMMENTED; a later, distinct APPROVED event preceded merge. A coordination comment explicitly reports inability to set awaiting-review.
relevance_to_draft: Any extension beyond cited source scope needs an owned supporting construction or explicit proof route.
Our internal AI verdict is not a repository approval event or independent human endorsement.
State a label-permission limitation if it actually applies when a PR is opened; no label or message was sent in this check.
